title: Clustering Categorical Data Streams
motivation: Web click streams and network intrusions generate massive categorical data needing one-pass analysis with bounded memory
problem_framing: Cluster categorical data streams where records arrive continuously, can only be read once, and memory is limited
key_insight: Apply lossy counting histogram approximation to Squeezer algorithm yields bounded memory one-pass categorical clustering
method_signature: StreamCluCD combines Squeezer clustering with lossy counting histogram pruning
evaluation_criteria: Clustering accuracy (vs Squeezer/k-modes), memory usage (entries), execution time (linearity), parameter sensitivity
evidence_for_taste: no algorithm exists for clustering categorical data streams
time needed must be small and constant
the algorithm is not sensitive to parameter st
clustering error did not change significantly
thinking_moves: Identify critical gap in streaming algorithms literature
Borrow lossy counting space-bounded technique from frequency mining
Prove space complexity bound, then verify empirically
Tune epsilon vs support threshold separately to understand parameter roles
cites_own_work: Squeezer: an efficient algorithm for clustering categorical data
